steps.title: Open Cursor
steps.body: Open the Cursor app and sign in.

steps.title: Add a remote connection
steps.body:
1. Click This Mac above the prompt box.
  2. Select Remote Machine.
  3. Click Connect via SSH.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Run on menu with Remote Machine and Connect via SSH

steps.title: Connect to eggie
steps.body: Type eggie in the search box, select the eggie connection and click Connect.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Connect via SSH dialog with the eggie connection

steps.title: Open the projects folder
steps.body: Wait while Cursor installs what it needs. Then select the projects folder and click Open.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Select Folder dialog with the projects folder

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.alt: Screenshot · Cursor prompt, connected to eggie in ~/projects

cloud.warning: Unzip the eggie-…_ed25519.zip file you downloaded from Eggie. It holds two files: your key is the one without .pub at the end.

card.label: SSH key
card.hint: Unzip the eggie-…_ed25519.zip you downloaded from Eggie. It is usually in your Downloads folder. Use the file without .pub at the end.

steps.title: Connect to your kitchen
steps.body:
Type the SSH host from the card below and press Enter.

When Cursor asks for a key, choose the unzipped key file, the one without .pub.

steps.title: Run it in WSL
steps.body:
1. Open the environment menu next to the prompt box.
  2. Select Remote Machines.
  3. Select Connect…
  4. Select WSL.
